TERMS_OF_SERVICE.title: Terms and conditions
TERMS_OF_SERVICE.intro: These terms govern the use of RapiChonta, the delivery service of Villagarzón, Putumayo. By creating your account you accept them.

sections.heading: What RapiChonta is
paragraphs: RapiChonta connects customers with registered stores and with couriers who buy and deliver the orders. For now the service only runs in Villagarzón and you can only order from registered stores.

sections.heading: Your account
paragraphs: You sign in with your mobile number and a code we text you. The code is personal: don't share it with anyone, not even someone claiming to be from RapiChonta.
You're responsible for keeping your details accurate and for what's done with your account. You can sign out or delete your data at any time from My account.

sections.heading: Orders and payments
paragraphs: The order price is what the store charges plus the delivery fee shown before you confirm. You pay on delivery: cash, or Nequi, Daviplata or a transfer to the courier's account.
If a product isn't available, we tell you before buying it so you can decide. When you receive the order, you confirm the delivery in the app.

sections.heading: Fair use
paragraphs: Don't use RapiChonta for fake orders, for products banned by law, or to harass couriers or staff. We may suspend accounts that break these terms.

sections.heading: Liability
paragraphs: Products are the responsibility of the store that sells them. RapiChonta is responsible for the purchase and delivery made by its couriers under the conditions shown on each order.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: If we change these terms we'll publish a new version and ask you to accept it before you keep using the service.

DATA_PROCESSING_POLICY.title: Personal data processing policy
DATA_PROCESSING_POLICY.intro: We comply with Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1377 of 2013 (compiled in Decree 1074 of 2015). Here we explain what data we process, why, and how to exercise your rights.

sections.heading: Controller
paragraphs: RapiChonta is the controller of the data collected through its website and app. You can reach us through the support channels listed in the app.

sections.heading: Data we process
paragraphs: Customers: name, mobile number, delivery addresses, preferred language and order history.
Couriers and staff: also ID document, vehicle, payout accounts and, for couriers on shift only, their location.
Technical data: device, IP address and sign-in records, to protect your account.

sections.heading: What we use it for
paragraphs: To create and protect your account, take and deliver your orders, contact you about them, handle complaints and meet legal and accounting obligations. We don't sell your data.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
paragraphs: The courier carrying your order sees your name, address and a contact number. We use providers to send SMS and host the information, under the same confidentiality obligations.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can access, update and correct your data; request proof of your authorization; learn how we use it; revoke the authorization and ask us to delete it; and file complaints with the Superintendency of Industry and Commerce (SIC).
From My account you can update your name and phone number, and delete your data. We answer queries within 10 business days and complaints within 15 business days.

sections.heading: Deletion
paragraphs: When you delete your data we erase your name, phone number, addresses and documents, and close your account. Order records the law requires us to keep remain without anything that identifies you.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We protect information with encryption in transit, irreversibly stored passwords and codes, expiring sessions, and audit logs of staff actions.

COURIER_LOCATION_AUTHORIZATION.title: On-shift location authorization
COURIER_LOCATION_AUTHORIZATION.intro: RapiChonta couriers accept this authorization. It explains when and why we use your location.

sections.heading: When it's used
paragraphs: Only while you're on shift in the courier app. When your shift ends we stop receiving your location.

sections.heading: What for
paragraphs: To offer you the nearest orders, know which step each delivery is at (at the store, on the way, delivered) and handle incidents.
Customers don't see your live location: only their order status.

sections.heading: How long it's kept
paragraphs: We keep positions as long as needed for operations and to settle order complaints; then they're deleted or kept without identifying you.

sections.heading: Revoking
paragraphs: You can revoke this authorization. Without it you can't receive orders, because assignment depends on proximity.
